scope: Corollary 8.3 (Tate conjecture for abelian varieties over finite fields) of the manuscript “The rational Hodge conjecture for CM abelian varieties” (preprints/The-rational-Hodge-conjecture-for-CM-abelian-varieties-October-6-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 032 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 6e3e66a407773ad5), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 49. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every abelian variety A/Fq, every integer r ≥ 0, and every prime ℓ ̸= char(Fq), the cycle-class map CHr (A) ⊗Z Qℓ −→ H2r ét (Ā, Qℓ(r))Gq is surjective. Numerical equivalence and ℓ-adic homological equivalence coincide on rational algebraic cycles on Ā.
